listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and ports the DNSCrypt proxy listens on for client DNS queries.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Set to 0 for no limit.

fallback_resolvers.description: Fallback plain DNS resolvers used when upstream encrypted resolvers fail.

disable_ipv6.description: If true, disable IPv6 support on the proxy itself (does not affect upstream resolvers).

log_file.description: Path to the main log file. Leave empty to log to stdout.

use_syslog.description: If true, send logs to the system logger (e.g., systemd/journald) instead of a file.

server_cert.description: Path to the server certificate (PEM format) for local DNSCrypt relays (empty = none).

server_key.description: Path to the server private key (PEM format) for local DNSCrypt relays (empty = none).

cache_file.description: Path to the cached resolver list (to reduce repeated downloads).

cache_file_min_time.description: Minimum time (seconds) to keep the resolver cache before checking for updates.

cache_file_max_time.description: Maximum time (seconds) to keep the resolver cache before expiry (0 = no expiration).

disable_insecure_resolver_selection.description: If true, only use authenticated resolver lists over HTTPS (disables insecure HTTP lists).

server_names.description: List of resolver names (from the server list) to use. Must match entries in the server list.

resolver_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a response from a resolver per query.

dnscrypt_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing a DNSCrypt connection to a resolver.

doh_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing a DoH (DNS over HTTPS) connection to a resolver.

max_connections_per_query.description: Maximum number of parallel connections tried for a single query.

rate_limit.description: Maximum queries per second per resolver (0 = no rate limiting).

firewall_rules_file.description: Path to an optional script that configures firewall rules for the proxy (e.g., allow port 53).

blocklist.domains.description: List of domain names to block. Matches full domains exactly.

blocklist.file.description: Path to a file with one blocked domain per line (supports wildcards like *.ads.com).

whitelist.domains.description: List of domains to always allow, even if blocked elsewhere.

whitelist.file.description: Path to a file with one allowed domain per line (whitelist takes precedence over blocklist).

ip_filters.blocked_ranges.description: List of CIDR ranges to block (e.g., ['192.168.0.0/16']).

ip_filters.allowed_ranges.description: If non-empty, only allow queries from these CIDR ranges (allowlist mode).

ip_filters.block_localhost.description: If true, reject queries from localhost (127.0.0.1 or ::1). Not recommended.

per_ip_log_directory.description: Directory to store per-client IP query logs (empty = disabled).

per_ip_log_retention_days.description: Number of days to keep per-IP logs before deletion.

stats_per_resolver.description: If true, collect per-resolver statistics (used by stats_file and metrics).

stats_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing resolver usage statistics.

stats_max_age.description: Maximum age (seconds) of stats before rotation (0 = no rotation).

metrics.enabled.description: If true, enable Prometheus-style metrics endpoint.

metrics.listen_address.description: IP and port to serve Prometheus metrics on.

post_reload_command.description: Optional shell command to run after the service is reloaded (e.g., to refresh firewall rules).

pre_reload_command.description: Optional shell command to run before reloading the config (e.g., to backup state).

on_startup.description: Optional shell command to run once when the proxy starts.

on_shutdown.description: Optional shell command to run when the proxy shuts down cleanly.

logrotate_config.description: Path to the logrotate configuration file for the proxy logs.
